The Chinese characters for Rafael

As a transliteration, Rafael is usually written 拉斐尔 (Lā fěi ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

斐
fěi

尔

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Rafael carries the meaning “God has healed (form of Raphael)”.

About the name Rafael

The archangel Raphael, a healer, appears in the Book of Tobit.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Rafael carries the meaning “God has healed (form of Raphael)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
